preconditions.description: The number of cities is between 4 and 1000, inclusive.
The maximum number of roads is between n - 1 and 2n - 2, inclusive.
The cities are numbered between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: a != b and a != c and a != d and b != c and b != d and c != d
preconditions.description: The cities a, b, c, and d are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or two valid paths with at most k roads.

invariants.expression: all(len(path) == n for path in paths)
invariants.description: Each path has exactly n cities.

invariants.expression: all(city in range(1, n + 1) for path in paths for city in path)
invariants.description: Each city in the paths is a valid city number.

invariants.expression: all(path[0] == start_city for path, start_city in zip(paths, [a, c]))
invariants.description: The first city of each path is the corresponding start city.

invariants.expression: all(path[-1] == end_city for path, end_city in zip(paths, [b, d]))
invariants.description: The last city of each path is the corresponding end city.

invariants.expression: all(path[i] != path[i + 1] for path in paths for i in range(n - 1))
all(len(set(road for i in range(n - 1) for road in [(path[i], path[i + 1]), (path[i + 1], path[i])])) <= k for path in paths)
invariants.description: Each path contains at most k distinct roads.
